propositions.name: BFS Queue Invariant
propositions.statement: Breadth-first search visits vertices in non-decreasing order of edge distance from the source using a FIFO queue.

arguments.statement: Explain why replacing a FIFO queue with a LIFO stack in graph traversal changes shortest-path guarantees on unweighted graphs.
arguments.modelSolution: A FIFO queue processes all vertices at distance d before any at distance d+1, whereas a LIFO stack explores deep paths first and may discover a target along a longer path before shorter ones.
